clean-tree.label: clean working tree
clean-tree.install: Commit or stash outstanding changes first

cmux-notification-hooks.label: cmux Notification+Stop hooks
cmux-notification-hooks.install: Add async Notification and Stop hooks running `cmux wait-for` to ~/.claude/settings.json

cmux-session.label: cmux workspace
cmux-session.install: Run with at least one active cmux workspace

gh.label: GitHub CLI
gh.install: brew install gh && gh auth login

git-repo.label: git repository
git-repo.install: Run from inside a git repository

github-remote.label: GitHub-hosted remote
github-remote.install: The repo remote must resolve to github.com — a GitLab or Bitbucket remote does not satisfy this

interactive-user.label: interactive user
interactive-user.install: Requires an interactive session (AskUserQuestion); unavailable headless

juel:regression.label: juel:regression
juel:regression.install: Ships with this plugin (not implemented yet — a later task adds it)

linear.label: Linear MCP
linear.install: Ships as a plugin dependency; authorize the connector, then restart the session

open-pr.label: open PR
open-pr.install: The current branch needs an open pull request (`gh pr view`)

permission-mode-auto.label: --permission-mode auto
permission-mode-auto.install: Relaunch with --permission-mode acceptEdits if auto is rejected (never bypassPermissions)

plan-file.label: plan file
plan-file.install: An implementation plan must exist under docs/.superpowers/plans/

resolved-install-command.label: project install command
resolved-install-command.install: Resolved at runtime from the repo's own install/resolution layer (e.g. `make install`); there is no fixed install step — install project dependencies yourself if none resolves

superpowers:brainstorming.label: superpowers:brainstorming
superpowers:brainstorming.install: Ships as part of the superpowers plugin dependency

work-source-list-capable.label: work-source provider with list capability
work-source-list-capable.install: Configure a work-item provider that supports listing (e.g. Linear MCP), or paste refs / point at a spec directory

worktree-root-cwd.label: cwd at worktree root
worktree-root-cwd.install: Run with the working directory set to the worktree root

writable-cwd.label: writable cwd
writable-cwd.install: Run somewhere the current directory is writable (`test -w .`) — a permission claim, not a location claim
